storyCards.headline: Afternoon Delight: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Starland Vocal Band's "Afternoon Delight" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Afternoon Delight was released in 1976.
